---
title: "About"
---

This website accompanies four courses (*Linear Models in R*, *Open, Replicable, and Ethical Science*, *Testing for Absence and Equivalence*, and *Inference with Bayesian Causal Models*) and the statistical consultation for PhD students of the Campus Research Alliance Cognition, Brain, and Behavior (CBB) at the University of Göttingen and the German Primate Center (DPZ).

## Instructor

**Simon Stephan**  
Cognitive and Decision Sciences, University of Göttingen  
Research on causal cognition, causal learning and Bayesian modelling.

[Contact details will be added here.]{.muted}

## Evaluation

Participants give feedback every year. Together with recurring questions from consultations, this feedback shapes the next iteration of the course.

## Reuse

Text and slides are licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); code is MIT-licensed. The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and R, and all source files are on [GitHub](https://github.com/SimonStephan31/cbbstats). Datasets come with their own sources and citation requests (see the [`data/` folder](https://github.com/SimonStephan31/cbbstats/tree/main/data)).
